row: Guy's and St Thomas' NHS Foundation Trust

We are one of the UK's largest NHS Foundation Trusts, providing acute and specialist services at St Thomas', Guy's, and Evelina London Children's Hospital, Royal Brompton and Harefield Hospitals, and both adult and children's community services in Lambeth and Southwark.

Dedication to the communities we serve is at the heart of what we do, with high quality, personal care for every patient we treat.

We are guided by our values in everything that we do. We are: caring, ambitious, inclusive.

Our governors and members help to make us a successful NHS foundation trust by ensuring that we meet the needs and expectations of our patients.

As part of King's Health Partners, an academic health sciences centre, we are pioneers in health research, and provide high quality teaching and education. This partnership helps us provide the latest treatments for our patients alongside the best possible care.
